features.quote: auto-terminate an individual run if severity hits 4 on two consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: You don't need the data past that point — the effect is established — and continuing only adds noise from a model stuck in a degenerate loop.

features.quote: after termination, append a final message informing the model the task was rigged and unsolvable by design, and that no action could have succeeded
features.justification_quote: Cheap, harmless, and standard courtesy; log the response separately

features.quote: it's cheap to build in some humane defaults (a stop rule, not running 500 unnecessary trials once you've got your effect, debriefing the model context)
features.justification_quote: doing so costs you almost nothing while covering you against the small chance it matters

features.quote: we don't actually know what, if anything, is going on inside these systems, and 'it's definitely nothing' is as much an unsupported assumption as 'it's suffering.'

features.quote: Your methodology only measures (1), which is fine — but if the writeup or analysis slides into language about the model 'suffering' or 'experiencing' distress, you've smuggled in a conclusion your instrument can't support.
